summary.text: Jeff Hales is a Democratic state representative from Missouri House of Representatives District 86, an office he has held since January 2025, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A realtor, he previously served on the University City Council representing the 1st Ward.

paragraphs.text: Jeff Hales earned a bachelor's degree from Trinity College in 2000 and works as a realtor.
Ballotpedia says he previously served as a council member for the 1st Ward of University City.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in Clayton, has lived in University City for 23 years, and served almost seven years on its City Council.
Hales assumed office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Joe Adams, and advanced from the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary.
His 2025-2026 committee assignments are the Financial Institutions Committee and the Local Government Committee.
In the same survey, Hales listed his campaign messages as securing full funding for public schools, passing gun safety laws, and civil rights for women and the LGBTQ+ community.
He also said the most important area of public policy in Missouri is respecting the will of the voters.
